proposals.blocking_question: Each source row names 'Statistics Poland Data Portal' as a co-source, and the canonical notes say 'Eurostat / Statistics Poland'. The Eurostat dataflow lists only Eurostat as source institution, and no Statistics Poland terms are registered. Either the co-source wording is explained and GUS terms are reviewed, or the label is corrected through an owner-approved canonical data change (outside this phase).
